sectors.trend: Housing market under severe stress: 10% price correction forecast, developer insolvencies (Bathla), mortgage stress at highs; retail theft and small business strain noted

sectors.trend: Darwin hospital expansion signals public health spending; Qantas strike vote threatens QAN.AX operations; no major ASX healthcare catalysts today
sectors.implications: QAN.AX (QAN.AX) faces operational disruption risk from strike; CSL.AX, SGH.AX unaffected but benefit from defensive rotation

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over next 1–3 months. Fourth RBA rate hike, mortgage stress, and housing correction fears dominate. Oil-driven inflation keeps RBA on hawkish path. Gold and energy names outperform; property and rate-sensitive sectors lag. Qantas strike adds idiosyncratic risk. Expect ^AXJO volatility in 7,200–7,600 range.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. Productivity 'bad to worse' and per capita recession cap earnings growth. Housing correction may deepen, pressuring banks' credit lines. However, commodity strength (gold, coal, oil) supports materials/energy. Energy transition (solar overtaking coal in China) creates structural headwinds for thermal coal long-term. RBA likely to pause after 4th hike, providing relief by Q1 2027.
